The two best value picks are the Blumat 6 Sensor Drip Irrigation Kit - Gravity and the Blumat 10-Pack Starter Kit.

The 6 Sensor Drip Irrigation Kit is the more complete option. It includes the tubing, splitters, end pieces, tank connector, and pipette, so it is the better buy if you want a fuller working setup for up to 6 plants.

The 10-Pack Starter Kit gives you more sensors, but it is more stripped down. It includes 10 carrots, tubing, a thru-hull adapter, and an end piece, so it makes more sense if you want the lowest cost per sensor and do not mind building out the system a bit more.

If you want the safer all-around value pick, go with the 6 Sensor Drip Irrigation Kit.

turns.q: Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?
turns.replyTail:
6 Sensor Drip Irrigation Kit - Gravity
$66.00
Blumat Irrigation Kit - 10-Pack Starter Kit

The cheaper one is fine if you want a simple way to get started. The pricier 10-Pack Starter Kit is worth it if you already know you want more coverage right away, since it gives you 10 carrots instead of 6 and can be expanded further.

For most people, the 6 Sensor Drip Irrigation Kit is the better value pick. It is the one I would choose unless you already need those extra sensors now.
